description: This file defines an interface 'UriFactoryInterface' for creating URI objects in a PSR HTTP Message implementation. It declares a method createUri for generating URI instances from string inputs.

classes.name: UriFactoryInterface
classes.description: An interface defining a factory method for creating URI instances in PSR-7 HTTP message implementations.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates a new UriInterface instance from the given URI string, or an empty string to create a default/empty URI.
